title: ProductPrd:ConnectShorts

_meta.purpose: Connect Shorts PRD: short-form video product combining TikTok FYP and Instagram Reels patterns — for-you feed, duets, stitches, effects, LIVE streaming, creator monetization — with strict professional/personal dual-context isolation, Foundry agentic relevance ranking, and Workflow/Ontology/Ads ecosystem integration.

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure and root Makefile/oya ops targets; no manual SSH troubleshooting path

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:shorts>-<layer:kernel>; kernel is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns pure domain types, port traits, and no-I/O invariants for the bounded context
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: declares Workflow/Ontology ports for cross-product integration; does not call other product crates

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:shorts>-<layer:domain>; domain is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns business rules and implements/uses kernel ports without adapter dependencies
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: uses kernel ports only; cross-product state is mediated by Workflow/Ontology contracts

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:shorts>-<layer:app>; app is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns composition/usecase orchestration and wires domain behavior to protocol adapters
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: orchestrates Workflow/Ontology adapters at the composition boundary

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<product:connect>-<bounded-context:shorts>-<layer:rest>; rest is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the product/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns HTTP route/DTO mapping and calls inward; no domain rules live here
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: exposes protocol-specific handlers and delegates inward; direct cross-product calls are forbidden

identity.naming_justification: All planned connect-shorts crates parse as oya-connect-shorts-<layer>; ADR-0056 supplies the BNF discipline and ADR-0105 supplies the canonical layer enum.

video editor, effects studio, duet/stitch tools, creator analytics, monetization

acceptance_criteria.given: a user watches videos in personal context
acceptance_criteria.then: watch history is keyed by context_kind=personal; signals are never written to the professional Foundry relevance model training pipeline

acceptance_criteria.given: a user creates a duet with a personal-context video
acceptance_criteria.then: the duet artifact inherits context_kind=personal from the source video; it is denied from the professional feed index

acceptance_criteria.given: a Foundry FYP model produces a ranked feed
acceptance_criteria.when: the feed is served to a user
acceptance_criteria.then: the ranked list contains only artifacts with matching context_kind; the model training data contains no cross-context signals

acceptance_criteria.given: a creator initiates a LIVE stream
acceptance_criteria.then: the stream is context-scoped; personal LIVE streams are not discoverable in professional search; gift/virtual-currency transactions are context-isolated

acceptance_criteria.given: a professional short-form video (e.g. product demo) is published in work context
acceptance_criteria.then: Workflow receives a ShortsContentPublished event with consent token; the video may be cross-posted to professional social feed via Workflow; personal feed is never consulted

acceptance_criteria.when: a revenue event (ad impression, virtual gift, subscription view) occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: revenue is attributed to the correct context; personal creator revenue is never visible to employer; professional brand revenue flows through Workflow billing contract

preview: for-you feed (personal + professional, separate Foundry models)
basic in-app video editor (trim, speed, music from licensed catalog)
stable: LIVE streaming (personal and professional with separate discovery indexes)
virtual gifting (personal context; professional context uses Workflow billing)
Ontology creator graph (follower/following edges per context)
Workflow cross-post automation for professional content
GA: creator monetization: ad revenue share, fan subscriptions, brand partnerships (context-scoped)
in-app e-commerce product tagging (personal: consumer shop; professional: B2B product catalog)
Foundry real-time FYP model updates per context
regional packs: KR, US, EU locale UX + content-moderation overlays
Ads integration (context-isolated; personal ad signals never cross to professional model)

dual_context_isolation.mechanism: separate Foundry relevance model instances per context_kind; ShortsForYouFeed, ShortsDiscoveryIndex, ShortsCreatorAnalytics, and ShortsMonetizationLedger are each pillar-keyed; Cedar policy denies cross-pillar reads at domain layer
dual_context_isolation.relevance_model_isolation: personal FYP model and professional FYP model are separate Foundry model artifacts; training pipelines share no data
dual_context_isolation.monetization_isolation: personal creator revenue ledger and professional brand revenue ledger are separate aggregates keyed by context_kind

ShortsVideoArtifact — typed Ontology node with creator, tags, duet chain, and stitch references
